notes: Fixes installing Nexus Launcher: Deckhand now finds its download. The project's current release names its files Xodus-Nexus-<version>-<arch>.AppImage, and Deckhand only looked for the newer Nexus-Launcher-… name, so it said it couldn't find the download. It now accepts both, searches recent releases if the latest has no AppImage, and lists the files it saw when nothing matches.
